acceptance.performance: Reject on control drift >5%, nonpositive paired gain, changed work counts, unpinned inputs, any oracle failure, or inconsistent stratum. Retain all repetitions. A positive screen is provisional until independent confirmation; no automatic promotion.

experiment: Six-token input is a negative fallback control. Positive pinned 64/65/84-token screens must record 40 D256 and 8 D512 encodes. Exercise nonidentity pages, window edges, masked future tokens, holes, and malformed page indices in the separate local component adapter before full-model acceptance. Compare to off/MMA/SIMD first; measure old metal-gqa-kv8 as a separate secondary control, never combine selectors. After the unchanged tensor and continuation gates pass, use 84-token ABBA and independently confirm at 256/1008 tokens. The proposed runtime does not enter the >1024-prefix eviction regime; a host window-edge algebra test is not evidence for that unsupported hardware regime.
risks: Overlapping temporal windows still load extra union rows; head reuse is sacrificed relative to old GQA.
Metadata/page holes and inactive tail SIMD groups must not bypass barriers or hide NaNs.
incompatibility: One performance candidate per arm. Do not combine new candidates with each other or the original six until individual effects are independently established.

component_screen.geometry: Sliding D256/KV8 and global D512/KV1, M in [64,65,84,255,256,1023,1024], one request and context capacity <=1024.
component_screen.oracle: Dense gathered-page reference under original tolerances; nonidentity page map, inactive tail groups, causal positions, holes and nonfinite/invalid-page diagnostics. Six-token and >1024-capacity cases are fallback controls, not positive trials.
component_screen.adapter_status: Native component adapter not supplied or qualified; local owner must preserve checked buffer extents and all-lane barriers.
